records.title: Cotton MS Caligula D VII: French embassy letters and surrender negotiations
shelfmarks: ff.63r–v Dec 1518 Earl of Worcester on surrender
records.note: Direct indexed evidence treaty implementation negotiations proceeded into Dec 1518, in between October cession treaty and February 1519 garrison handover; originals not read.

records.title: Original 4 October 1518 Tournai treaty warrant
shelfmarks: Cotton MS Vitellius C XI, ff169r–189v (as cross-referenced in Add MS48002)
records.note: Original warrant reported in BL catalogue; 1518 agreed cession and 1519 actual physical return kept separate.

records.title: Flodden battlefield designated boundary coordinates

shelfmarks: Historic England designated battlefield 1000011; approximate official reference point (-2.167046,55.626989)
records.note: Not accurate battlefield troop routes; helps place a battlefield site marker; this is NOT evidence of permanent territorial transfer.
